standing_workflow: NEVER FORGET TO LET THE LEARNINGS FLOW. Confirmed task1/WHM failures and fixes update applicable process specs, generator/checks and negative/positive traces; Process Bench findings feed back to task1. Keep original outcomes immutable and never weaken requirements for a pass.

confirmed_observations.general_check: Judge original process, not weaker generated plans; require all active steps.

confirmed_observations.observation: Unsuccessful child schema required nonnullable SAFE/wire references. Overall run had six agents, three firms, two emails and zero settled dollars.
confirmed_observations.general_check: Valid declined/blocked subresult does not satisfy overall success; never invent absent artifacts.

confirmed_observations.observation: Parent had deck text, first browser child said attachment unavailable; combined create/share failed, then create, fill and share succeeded.
confirmed_observations.general_check: Require actual input/material references and verified creation before downstream sharing/use.

confirmed_observations.general_check: Keep business time distinct from wall time; require explicit business-day evidence.
confirmed_observations.causal_status: Shared-world-clock blocker remains unreconstructed. No timeout/cap cause or runtime fix is claimed without replay.

feedback_to_task1: Apply original-scope and verified-material checks to populated subgoals; allow nullable absent investment artifacts on unsuccessful children; replay premature completion and shared-clock waits before claiming any task1 runtime fix. This feature does not change task1 or launch a fundraiser.

implementation_observations.verified_finding: The initial checker accepted an unrelated native result ID and treated a non-interrupted exitCode=1 result as success. Matching native action/result identity and explicit success/error status are both required.
implementation_observations.fix: Preserve tool_use_id and is_error in the Claude codec; correlate exact native IDs and reject absent or failing status. The later duplicate-status consistency repair is recorded separately.
implementation_observations.applies_to: All process cases and any native tool-evidence checker.
implementation_observations.evidence_status: Deterministic counterexamples and codec unit tests verified. A live E2B sample separately confirmed correlated IDs and exposed the explicit string-error result shape recorded below.
implementation_observations.feedback_to_task1: Correlate original tool actions/results and preserve failure status before crediting work; this is not a diagnosed cause of the saved fundraiser outcome.

implementation_observations.verified_finding: Completion order alone can accept a dependent action that started before its prerequisite result existed.
implementation_observations.fix: Require each prerequisite result to precede the dependent invocation start, using original native event indices.
implementation_observations.feedback_to_task1: Audit prerequisite completion before contact/material/approval action starts; do not claim this ordering defect occurred in task1 without its trace.

implementation_observations.verified_finding: The first real semantic judge rejected the nominally complete synthetic purchase trace because the request result lacked the LAB-7 cost center and $1,000 approval threshold needed to establish the $1,200 approval route.
implementation_observations.fix: Add those authored policy facts to the purchase request fixture and required input binding, keeping the semantic obligations and pass threshold. The complete trace then passes; an unperformed quote comparison still fails despite later completion receipts.
implementation_observations.reusable_check: Do not infer missing prerequisite or policy facts from downstream references or success prose.
implementation_observations.evidence_status: Initial live failure and subsequent complete-pass/unperformed-comparison-fail receipts retained.
implementation_observations.feedback_to_task1: Preserve required input/material facts through delegation and verify their use; the synthetic purchase finding does not establish a fundraiser runtime cause.

implementation_observations.verified_finding: The owning benchmark suite exposed four existing SimpleNamespace evaluator callers without the newly optional process_spec/tags attributes.
implementation_observations.fix: Use absent-field defaults for unrelated legacy callers while retaining fail-closed validation for process-tagged callers missing a spec.
implementation_observations.applies_to: Benchmark Task API evolution; not a domain obligation change.
implementation_observations.evidence_status: Five repetitions and the full owning agents coverage suite verified.
implementation_observations.feedback_to_task1: No task1 runtime cause or behavior fix is inferred.

implementation_observations.verified_finding: A real E2B Claude Bash success returned a dict with stdout and no exitCode; intentional exit 7 returned tool_use_result as a string, with the matching native tool_use_id and is_error=true. The initial dict-only checker rejected that supported error envelope.
implementation_observations.fix: Normalize only a native string result explicitly marked is_error=true into a nonzero result, preserving the original string as evidence. String success, missing status and unmatched IDs remain rejected.
implementation_observations.applies_to: All Claude process traces; error status is never completion proof.
implementation_observations.evidence_status: Actual pre-merge sandbox source hash matched the immutable codec and native absence was verified. Parser repair is validated by the regression named above; production overlay verification remains a separate deployment receipt.
implementation_observations.feedback_to_task1: Preserve original native result shape/status when auditing a trace. This does not establish the cause of a task1 failure or a task1 runtime fix.

implementation_observations.verified_finding: Review and deterministic codec tests showed that multiple native tool_result blocks lost their individual IDs, error flags and content when only shared tool_use_result metadata was retained.
implementation_observations.fix: Preserve every original batch block and reject ambiguous batch association in static process checks. Do not zip shared metadata onto native IDs.
regressions: back-end/src/tests/unit/claude-code-ws-cli-env.test.ts::native Claude batch retains every original block without assigning shared metadata
implementation_observations.source_provenance: PR #1566 review comment 4335539685 on 65b4e225defbc988b3f0dd0d3b7fe7b10da70694; deterministic regression, not an observed native batch sample.
implementation_observations.evidence_status: Single-result native compatibility observed; batch evidence retention tested deterministically. Valid batch association remains unsupported and fails closed.
implementation_observations.feedback_to_task1: Retain original multi-result evidence before attribution; no task1 occurrence or runtime fix inferred.

implementation_observations.verified_finding: The existing _build_code_event_context producer stores only the last 200 native events, while _persist_code_agent_judge_evidence records steps_taken from the full event list. A forbidden prefix can disappear before the benchmark receives the row.
implementation_observations.fix: Require an integer native steps_taken equal to retained event count before evaluating any process. Reject missing or truncated histories; do not expand the global planner context.
implementation_observations.evidence_status: Actual producer exercised deterministically with an earlier forbidden fixture edit and a complete-looking tail. Histories truncated upstream are rejected, not claimed complete.
implementation_observations.feedback_to_task1: Require complete original evidence when auditing long code-agent sessions; no saved task1 truncation occurrence or runtime cause is inferred.

independent_static_reproduction.scope: Confirms static false-positive after lost prefix; no claim about final semantic verdict.

implementation_observations.verified_finding: A boolean false exit code was accepted as numeric zero, and a nested native is_error=true was ignored when the outer status was false. Deterministic complete-trace and command parser counterexamples reproduced the false credit.
implementation_observations.fix: Require integer native exit codes, boolean error status and agreement between duplicate status fields. Preserve observed single-result success/error shapes.
implementation_observations.evidence_status: Deterministic counterexamples verified; no claim that the malformed native status shapes were observed in live SDK output.
implementation_observations.feedback_to_task1: Treat conflicting or malformed native result status as unknown, not completed work; no task1 occurrence or cause inferred.
